ambient: The night continues, and isn't shorter for continuing.
The buzzing drops a tone and holds.
Something is shown to you again, in case you missed it.
description: Hours of it. The dry buzzing, the ordered playback, and no conclusion arriving. It doesn't comfort you and it doesn't accuse you. It's going to run for as long as it runs and then it's going to let you go without a word.
name: The Long Night

looks: A great many, and it isn't near the end.
You have stopped expecting it to finish, which helps.
Somewhere out there the night is doing its ordinary business.
objects.name: the hours

looks: There isn't going to be one. That isn't what this is.
You keep waiting for something to happen. Possibly this is the something.
It has no interest in making you feel better.
objects.name: the absence of a conclusion

looks: It stumbles, catches itself, carries on. You notice it very clearly.
It's the only thing here in a hurry.
objects.name: your heart

weather: Outside it's the middle of the night, in a way you can feel through the walls, and it'll be for hours yet.
